name: Miki
source: Miki was supposed to be a normal girl with a promising future as a high jumper, but was forced to quit after an injury. Even worse, after the injury, she got into an accident which rid her of her parents and the use of her other leg. Ever since that, her life purpose has been to find and kill the person responsible for that "accident".
